desc: 圆头木质小车立在木轨条上，多色可选，配草地与积木场景好代入
leaf: 多彩木质滑行小汽车玩具（圆头木车身黑轮配金属轴帽，置于木轨条与拼插积木场景）
name: 多彩木质滑行小汽车玩具款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清是一辆圆头木质小车而非塑料电动车，抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
详情页首屏用一行大字加四个线性图标位承接主图点击，一秒给出第一购买理由。
shots.textZone: clean headline field across the top third, one support line directly beneath it, one row of four icon circles above the photo card

shots.intent: 把同款不同车身配色一字排开，替买家一次完成选色决策，也撑住礼盒与凑单场景。
shots.textZone: one short label inside each badge above a unit and one highlighted pill label under the row

shots.intent: 用左文右图的三行结构把车身、轮轴与轨道配合这三件事实讲清，回答怎么玩。
shots.textZone: left column with three stacked icon rows, heading line inside the top band

shots.intent: 用微距让漆面、木纹与金属轴帽自己说话，把做工证明交给画面而不是话术。
shots.textZone: one square accent badge in the lower corner holding a single short label

shots.intent: 把小车放进户外草地，用低角度与真实草叶做尺度参照，让家长代入孩子在地面推玩的画面。
把车顶、侧面、前缘与尾部四轮位一次排齐，替买家看完结构再谈购买。
shots.textZone: heading across the top of the screen field and one short caption label under each card

shots.intent: 用到货实物一次摊开的确定感收掉风险，把件数与尺寸交给卖家自填占位而不编造检测结论。
shots.textZone: one dashed-keyline label box at the side carrying a heading and two short spec lines

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口，用大标题加一个明确按钮把看完的犹豫转成加购动作。
shots.textZone: heading and one support line inside the dashed panel, rounded CTA button below them

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF fields for packshot, variant row and flat lay; #EAF4D6 panel fields with one soft wavy or scalloped top edge for infographic screens; feature photos always sit inside a rounded card with a thin #FFFFFF keyline; a dashed #4E9A2F keyline box marks the closing screen; never a random stock interior behind an infographic
style.direction: fresh spring-green kids wooden-toy ecommerce, bright outdoor daylight mixed with clean wavy infographic panels
style.iconSystem: single-weight #4E9A2F thin-line circles used one per feature row, plus one solid #F5811C shape (circle above a variant unit, square tag at a photo-card corner) carrying a single short label in #FFFFFF; no filled emblems, no certificate artwork, no seals, no QR codes
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced 5600K soft key from the upper left with a thin bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadow under every wheel, controlled highlights on painted wood and on the metal axle caps, no blown speculars; the single outdoor screen uses 5200K natural sun from camera right with all shadows falling consistently left
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh spring-green kids wooden-toy ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF base field, #EAF4D6 panel field and #2D2D2D body ink, with #4E9A2F headline ink and one swappable #F5811C accent badge {accent_color}; neutral daylight tone; one modern geometric rounded sans-serif family, heavy #4E9A2F headlines at 32-44pt, 16-20pt sublines and 10-14pt labels, all copy carried only as short placeholders; background system of seamless #FFFFFF fields for product boards and #EAF4D6 panels with one soft wavy top edge for infographic screens, feature photos always inside a rounded card with a thin #FFFFFF keyline; lighting system of a 5600K soft key from the upper left with thin bounce fill, true contact shadows under every wheel and controlled highlights on painted wood and metal axle caps; surface system of pale #F3EFE7 board, plain natural wood slat rail and deep #3F7A24 grass as the only outdoor ground; icon system of single-weight #4E9A2F thin-line circles plus one solid #F5811C badge holding a single short label; product always rendered true to the reference with stable scale and never floating without a contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no brush or handwritten lettering, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors beyond {accent_color}
no mixed fonts, no brush or handwritten display lettering, no cartoon or serif lettering
no random backgrounds and no stock-photo interiors on infographic screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing wheel contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy, no watermark
style.presentationRules: body color, wheel color, metal cap finish and proportions come only from the reference image and never shift between screens; the vehicle keeps the same scale and the same wheel-to-rail contact in every screen; at least one overhead and one low camera per set; product never floats without a contact shadow; no recognizable child face anywhere
style.surfaceSystem: pale #F3EFE7 matte board or a plain natural wood slat rail strip as the tabletop language, living grass in deep #3F7A24 as the only outdoor ground; surfaces stay clean, debris-free, with no duplicated prop pattern
style.typography: one modern geometric rounded sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; heavy weight for headlines only (32-44pt, solid #4E9A2F), medium 16-20pt for sublines in #4E9A2F, regular 10-14pt labels in #2D2D2D; all rendered copy is short 「{selling_point_N}」 and 「{callout_N}」 placeholders, per-screen budget under 40 characters
